product.name: Dynamic SDK

product.name: Dynamic Embedded Wallets with TSS-MPC
product.description: An enterprise-grade embedded wallet solution using Threshold Signature Scheme Multi-Party Computation for secure transaction signing without exposing private keys.

product.name: Account Abstraction Modules
product.description: Pre-configured modules that simplify Web3 user experience by enabling gas sponsorship, session keys, and transaction batching.
